# Unresolved Dependencies — tencentos-3.1-x86_64
# Status: ALL UNRESOLVED — platform not available
# Date: 2026-07-22
# Reference: NONE (independent closure required — different glibc base)

UNRESOLVED: No TencentOS 3.1 environment
UNRESOLVED: glibc version not confirmed (expected 2.28)
UNRESOLVED: DNF modularity behavior unknown
UNRESOLVED: Package names not confirmed (el8 vs el7)
UNRESOLVED: Tencentsm vs OpenSSL not determined
UNRESOLVED: TXSQL binary from centos-7.9 build not tested

CRITICAL: This platform MUST have an INDEPENDENT dependency closure.
  Do NOT copy centos-7.9 RPMs — they have el7 releases.
  All packages will have el8 (or tl3) releases.
  DNF handles dependency resolution differently from yum.

Resolution path:
  1. Obtain TencentOS 3.1 environment
  2. Run collect-fingerprints.sh
  3. Set up independent repo snapshot
  4. Run resolve-dependencies.sh against TencentOS 3.1 repos
  5. Compute FULL independent closure
  6. Test centos-7.9-built binary for forward compatibility
  7. IF binary works → shared TXSQL binary, independent dep repo
  8. IF binary fails → independent build (Strategy B)
